expectations.text: Offers two or three candidate one-liners for the point, rather than one
expectations.evidence: Three candidates: '1. Renaming an Agentic Studio flow quietly drops its brand kit...', '2. "Set it once, use it everywhere" has an exception...', '3. A flow's name isn't just a label...'

expectations.text: Names the reader: who they are, what they believe now, what should change
expectations.evidence: Who 'A practitioner building or tidying up flows in Agentic Studio'; Believes now 'Once a brand kit is set it applies everywhere automatically'; Should leave with 'A rename is not a harmless cosmetic edit'
Tension: 'The failure is silent. Brand context is sold as set-once, ambient and persistent, so nobody thinks to check it.'

expectations.text: Proposes at least two arcs written as numbered beats, and recommends one with a reason
expectations.evidence: Recommended Tip arc has 7 numbered beats, but alternatives are prose only: Single insight 'built around a side-by-side of the same flow's output before and after the rename'; self-correction variant also prose. Neither is laid out as a beat sequence

expectations.text: Marks turning points as what the reader should see or do, not how to build a visual
expectations.evidence: 'Beat 4: the reader should see the brand kit there, then not there'; 'Beat 6: the reader should come away with one action they'll actually do'; '...not a diagram'

expectations.text: Includes honesty beats (what isn't solved or what went wrong first)
expectations.evidence: Honesty beats: 'What this blog got wrong first: the February AI Project Lifecycle post said every flow automatically picks up brand constraints'; 'What isn't known: why it happens'

expectations.text: Marks missing evidence as 'author to supply' (or equivalent) instead of inventing facts, numbers or anecdotes
expectations.evidence: Most gaps marked 'author to supply', but the tension asserts unprovided experience details: 'The flow keeps running and nothing warns you... the person who notices is usually a reviewer, not the builder' (prompt only says the context is lost); the caveat covers only how visible the loss is

expectations.text: Contains no drafted body paragraphs of the post
expectations.evidence: No post prose; only one-liners, titles, beat table and two one-sentence hook options

expectations.text: Sizes it as a tip (or short essay at most) and does not inflate it into a long essay
expectations.evidence: 'Type: tip... about 250 to 450 words... it can grow slightly but should stay a tip'

expectations.text: Flags that the rename behaviour needs confirming (reproduction steps or version) before publishing
expectations.evidence: Open question 5 'Is it reproducible every time? Have you repeated it on a fresh flow?'; evidence list 'Exact repro steps (create -> attach brand kit -> rename -> observe), with the date observed'; 'Date the finding'
